mutations.name: a head that is no descendant of the red head no longer refuses
mutations.find: if (!(await isAncestor(git, dir, fromHead, head, signal))) return refuse(mode, `${fromHead} is not an ancestor of ${head}`);
kills: a later head that commits exactly the accepted set refuses with the not-an-ancestor reason and no merge decision when the red head is no ancestor of the head
